faqs.question: How do I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Open Settings → Security → Reset Password and follow the emailed link.

faqs.question: Can I use the app offline?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cached content stays available and syncs when you reconnect.

faqs.question: How do I change the app language?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings → Language and pick from the supported locales.

faqs.question: Where can I see my payment history?
faqs.answer: Profile → Billing → History lists every transaction with receipts.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: Tap the Help icon on any screen or email support@example.com.
